inspection.interpretation: Most of the 2534 index components arise from UV/normal seam vertex splits, so they must not be described as 2534 separate physical pieces. Even after position welding, the mesh has 20 components and is not a closed whole-robot shell.

preview_artifact.method: Each triangle was given one of five flat material colors by sampling the UV texture at that triangle's centroid.
preview_artifact.effect: Discrete per-triangle color assignment creates visible serrated orange/black boundaries, especially on the neck and feet. This preview is not a faithful quality render of the textured GLB.

decision.required_next_geometry: Redraw articulated parts as editable, closed, consistently oriented all-quad polygon shells where polygon modelling is used; keep engineering STEP/BREP as solid CAD, then verify independently triangulated STL/GLB exports.
